relevance_note: Case report of a girl with a heterozygous TNFAIP3 variant, 'We found that there was a heterozygous mutation (c.436_437deTC) in the TNFAIP3 gene', plus a literature table of 29 earlier patients.
method_note: Case report of one patient plus Table 1, a literature summary of 29 previously published patients and 'This case' (30 rows). Table 1 has no per-patient label column, so the 29 literature patients are labelled 'Table 1 row k' (k = 1-29); row 30 ('This case') is the case-report patient, labelled 'patient' throughout. A short Python script transcribed Table 1 cells (sex, onset, mutation, diagnosis, reference) and built row-segment spans; I checked its output against the table and chose all features and checklist mappings by hand. Table 1 leaves the Pedigree, Mutation location and References cells empty for rows after the first of each family; visually they seem to continue the family above, but empty cells were recorded as not reported (family label, variant string, source reference). Variant rows for those rows (and Family 1 row 1, whose cell reads only 'TNFAIP3') keep variant_original_string 'not reported'; the gene tie for blank-cell rows comes from the table title. 'Oral mucosa, genital ulcer' was read as oral mucosal ulcer plus genital ulcer. 'Fever' alone was not taken as recurrent fever (only 'intermittent fever' in row 13). Onset 'Unknow' (row 19) recorded as not reported. Contradictions: (1) the patient's Table 1 row lists genital ulcers, but the text says parents denied a history of vulvar ulcer and the vulva had no abnormalities; (2) the row lists a nonspecific rash, but examination found no skin rash. Both rows emitted; checklist genital ulcers and skin lesions set to not reported. (3) The variant is written c.436-437deTC (abstract), c.436_437deTC (text, table) and c.436_437delTC (Figure 4 legend); the text form is recorded. (4) The Discussion says 'this case and the 48 cases reported so far are summarized in Table 1', but the table has 29 earlier cases and the Introduction says 30 cases including this one; n_patients_reported uses 30. (5) Family 1 cites Shigemura et al [14] (reference title: C243Y), while p.Cys243Tyr is printed for Family 3, which has an empty reference cell; recorded as printed. Patient age 2 years 3 months is the age at admission, not at last evaluation (follow-up to January 2021, age not given), so last-evaluation age is not reported. ANA 1:100 and anticardiolipin antibody 18 RU/mL are not called positive, so autoantibodies are not reported. Follow-up normal findings (colonoscopy, pulmonary CT without granuloma, normal knee ultrasound, anemia corrected) reflect resolution after treatment and were not emitted as excluded features. Parents' history denial of joint pain predates the observed knee synovitis; arthritis checklist observed from imaging. Normal heart/lung and neurological examinations were recorded as written and exclude nothing more specific. Zhou et al's patients in the Discussion are described only at group level and get no rows.
